mathematical_delta.summary: No mathematical object or canonical status was changed by this crawl.

findings.title: Bounded obligation disposition and promotion-gate status use different lifecycle vocabularies
findings.statement: The canonical D registry records one obligation as DISCHARGED and four as DISCHARGED_BOUNDED, while its registry status remains ACTIVE_OPEN and its promotion gate remains active. The live research-debt projection uses resolved while retaining theorem-promotion blockers and stating that no proof obligation was discharged.
premises: All five obligation entries have discharged or discharged-bounded dispositions.
The promotion gate explicitly blocks theorem or above-C1 promotion.
Analysis projections retain the bounded C1 ceiling and blocker.
implicit_assumptions: resolved means bounded research-debt disposition rather than promotion clearance
derivation_steps: Read live debt status, blocks, and notes.
Compare Analysis SSOT and program-state wording.
Preserve the distinction between bounded disposition and promotion eligibility.
proof_obligations: Define a shared lifecycle vocabulary or explicit status mapping.
Confirm whether ACTIVE_OPEN refers to the promotion gate rather than any individual obligation.

novelty.novel_contribution: Refines the earlier projection-drift finding into a specific bounded-disposition versus promotion-gate vocabulary mismatch.

falsification_conditions: A current authoritative status-mapping record demonstrates that ACTIVE_OPEN and resolved are intentionally scoped to different lifecycle layers and are already machine-linked.
findings.recommended_next_action: Prepare a separately authorized status-mapping/projection-alignment review; do not mutate the registries as part of this crawl.

blockers.effect: Theorem promotion and claims above C1 remain blocked.

contradictions.statement: The word resolved is used for live research debt while the same record retains active blockers and says no proof obligation was discharged; the canonical D registry uses ACTIVE_OPEN alongside discharged-bounded individual obligations.

not_established: Pi_D injectivity, reversibility, or complete information preservation
